```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(knitr)
})

payload <- fromJSON("landing_page_payload.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
report_files <- sort(list.files(".", pattern = "\\.html$", full.names = FALSE))
report_files <- setdiff(report_files, "index.html")

stage_order <- c("mapping", "barcode_v2", "ambient", "qc", "hvg", "integration", "annotation", "zoom")
stage_titles <- c(
  mapping = "Mapping",
  barcode_v2 = "Barcode v2",
  ambient = "Ambient",
  qc = "QC",
  hvg = "HVG",
  integration = "Integration",
  annotation = "Annotation",
  zoom = "Zoom"
)

known_reports <- list(
  mapping_report.html = list(title = "Mapping diagnostics", category = "Core", stage = "mapping", blurb = "Barcode knee plots and read-level mapping diagnostics across samples."),
  barcode_report_v2.html = list(title = "Barcode caller v2 audit", category = "Core", stage = "barcode_v2", blurb = "Audit outputs from the standalone barcode caller v2 workflow."),
  ambient_report.html = list(title = "Ambient RNA diagnostics", category = "Core", stage = "ambient", blurb = "decontX summaries, contamination estimates, and ambient cleanup diagnostics."),
  qc_report.html = list(title = "Cell-level QC", category = "Core", stage = "qc", blurb = "Filtering metrics, threshold summaries, and QC visualizations."),
  hvg_report.html = list(title = "HVG selection", category = "Core", stage = "hvg", blurb = "Highly variable gene selection diagnostics and ambient-gene context."),
  integration_report.html = list(title = "Integration diagnostics", category = "Core", stage = "integration", blurb = "Harmony integration, cluster structure, metadata overlays, and QC-feature UMAPs."),
  annotation_report.html = list(title = "Annotation diagnostics", category = "Core", stage = "annotation", blurb = "Marker-panel matching, cluster labels, and marker expression views."),
  index.html = list(title = "Landing page", category = "Meta", stage = "meta", blurb = "Run overview and links to all generated HTML reports.")
)

pretty_report_name <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(known_reports[[path]])) {
    return(known_reports[[path]]$title)
  }
  if (startsWith(path, "zoom_") && endsWith(path, "_report.html")) {
    zoom_name <- sub("^zoom_(.+)_report\\.html$", "\\1", path)
    zoom_name <- gsub("_", " ", zoom_name)
    zoom_name <- tools::toTitleCase(zoom_name)
    return(sprintf("Zoom: %s", zoom_name))
  }
  label <- sub("\\.html$", "", path)
  label <- gsub("_", " ", label)
  tools::toTitleCase(label)
}

report_category <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(known_reports[[path]])) {
    return(known_reports[[path]]$category)
  }
  if (startsWith(path, "zoom_")) {
    return("Zoom")
  }
  "Other"
}

report_stage <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(known_reports[[path]])) {
    return(known_reports[[path]]$stage)
  }
  if (startsWith(path, "zoom_")) {
    return("zoom")
  }
  "other"
}

report_blurb <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(known_reports[[path]])) {
    return(known_reports[[path]]$blurb)
  }
  if (startsWith(path, "zoom_")) {
    return("Subset rerun report for a configured zoom, including reintegration and top-marker summaries.")
  }
  "Generated HTML report from this pipeline run."
}

flatten_params <- function(x, section = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(data.frame(section = character(), parameter = character(), value = character()))
  }

  if (!is.list(x)) {
    return(data.frame(
      section = if (is.null(section)) "general" else section,
      parameter = if (is.null(section)) "value" else sub("^.+\\.", "", section),
      value = paste(as.character(x), collapse = ", "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(section = character(), parameter = character(), value = character()))
  }

  rows <- lapply(seq_along(x), function(i) {
    value <- x[[i]]
    key <- names(x)[i]
    if (is.null(key) || key == "") {
      key <- paste0("item_", i)
    }
    next_section <- if (is.null(section)) key else paste(section, key, sep = ".")

    if (is.list(value) && length(value) > 0 && !is.null(names(value))) {
      flatten_params(value, next_section)
    } else if (is.list(value)) {
      data.frame(
        section = if (is.null(section)) key else section,
        parameter = key,
        value = toJSON(value, auto_unbox = TRUE),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        section = if (is.null(section)) "general" else section,
        parameter = key,
        value = paste(as.character(value), collapse = ", "),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })

  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

step_labels <- c(
  mapping = "Mapping",
  barcode_v2 = "Barcode v2",
  ambient = "Ambient",
  qc = "QC",
  hvg = "HVG",
  integration = "Integration",
  annotation = "Annotation",
  zooms = "Zooms"
)

enabled_steps <- payload$pipeline_steps
step_badges <- vapply(names(step_labels), function(step_name) {
  is_enabled <- isTRUE(enabled_steps[[step_name]])
  sprintf(
    '<span class="stage-badge %s">%s</span>',
    if (is_enabled) "on" else "off",
    step_labels[[step_name]]
  )
}, character(1))

zoom_items <- payload$params$zoom$items
zoom_count <- if (is.null(zoom_items)) 0 else length(zoom_items)
params_df <- flatten_params(payload$params)
params_df$section <- gsub("\\.", " / ", params_df$section)
params_df <- params_df[order(params_df$section, params_df$parameter), ]

report_df <- data.frame(
  file = report_files,
  title = vapply(report_files, pretty_report_name, character(1)),
  category = vapply(report_files, report_category, character(1)),
  stage = vapply(report_files, report_stage, character(1)),
  blurb = vapply(report_files, report_blurb, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
report_df$stage_rank <- match(report_df$stage, stage_order)
report_df$stage_rank[is.na(report_df$stage_rank)] <- 999
report_df <- report_df[order(report_df$stage_rank, report_df$title), ]

has_report <- function(file_name) {
  file_name %in% report_df$file
}

stage_report_file <- function(stage_name) {
  stage_files <- report_df$file[report_df$stage == stage_name]
  if (length(stage_files) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  stage_files[[1]]
}

render_stage_node <- function(label, file_name = NA_character_, status = "active", extra_class = "") {
  classes <- paste(c("dag-node", status, extra_class), collapse = " ")
  if (!is.na(file_name) && nzchar(file_name)) {
    sprintf('<a class="%s" href="%s">%s</a>', classes, file_name, label)
  } else {
    sprintf('<span class="%s">%s</span>', classes, label)
  }
}

main_flow_nodes <- c("mapping", "ambient", "qc", "hvg", "integration", "annotation")
main_flow_html <- vapply(main_flow_nodes, function(stage_name) {
  status <- if (isTRUE(enabled_steps[[stage_name]])) "active" else "muted"
  render_stage_node(stage_titles[[stage_name]], stage_report_file(stage_name), status)
}, character(1))

barcode_node_html <- render_stage_node(
  stage_titles[["barcode_v2"]],
  stage_report_file("barcode_v2"),
  if (isTRUE(enabled_steps[["barcode_v2"]])) "active" else "muted"
)

zoom_df <- report_df[report_df$stage == "zoom", , drop = FALSE]
zoom_nodes_html <- if (nrow(zoom_df) > 0) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(zoom_df)), function(i) {
    render_stage_node(zoom_df$title[[i]], zoom_df$file[[i]], "active", "zoom")
  }, character(1))
} else {
  character(0)
}

report_sections <- split(report_df, factor(report_df$stage, levels = stage_order))
report_sections <- report_sections[vapply(report_sections, nrow, integer(1)) > 0]
```

```{r hero, results='asis'}
description_steps <- names(Filter(isTRUE, enabled_steps))
description_steps <- step_labels[description_steps]
description_text <- if (length(description_steps) > 0) {
  paste(description_steps, collapse = ", ")
} else {
  "No optional downstream stages"
}

cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="hero"><h1>%s</h1><p>This landing page summarises the current pipeline run, captures the effective configuration, and links to every generated HTML report. Enabled stages for this run: %s.</p><div class="meta-grid"><div class="meta-card"><div class="meta-label">Run name</div><div class="meta-value">%s</div></div><div class="meta-card"><div class="meta-label">Profile</div><div class="meta-value">%s</div></div><div class="meta-card"><div class="meta-label">Reports</div><div class="meta-value">%s</div></div><div class="meta-card"><div class="meta-label">Zoom reports</div><div class="meta-value">%s</div></div></div><div class="badge-row">%s</div></div>',
  payload$pipeline,
  description_text,
  payload$run_name,
  payload$profile,
  length(report_files),
  zoom_count,
  paste(step_badges, collapse = "")
))
```

## Run overview

* **Generated at:** `r payload$generated_at`
* **Output directory:** `r payload$output_dir`
* **Reports directory:** `r payload$reports_dir`
* **Raw data directory:** `r payload$params$input_output$raw_data_dir`
* **Chemistry:** `r payload$params$references$chemistry`

## Reports

### Pipeline flow

```{r pipeline_flow, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="dag-wrap">')
cat('<div class="dag-row">')
cat(paste(main_flow_html, collapse = '<span class="dag-arrow">&rarr;</span>'))
cat('</div>')
cat('<div class="dag-row branch">')
cat('<span class="dag-arrow">&boxur;</span>')
cat(barcode_node_html)
cat('</div>')
if (length(zoom_nodes_html) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="dag-row branch">')
  cat('<span class="dag-arrow">&boxur;</span>')
  cat(render_stage_node('Zoom subsets', NA_character_, 'active', 'zoom'))
  cat('<span class="dag-arrow">&rarr;</span>')
  cat(paste(zoom_nodes_html, collapse = '<span class="dag-arrow">&rarr;</span>'))
  cat('</div>')
}
cat('</div>')
```

```{r report_cards, results='asis'}
if (nrow(report_df) == 0) {
  cat('No report HTML files were staged into the landing page process.\n')
} else {
  for (section_name in names(report_sections)) {
    section_df <- report_sections[[section_name]]
    cat(sprintf('<div class="section-label">%s</div>', stage_titles[[section_name]]))
    cat('<div class="report-grid">')
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(section_df))) {
      row <- section_df[i, ]
      cat(sprintf(
        '<div class="report-card"><div class="kicker">%s</div><h3>%s</h3><p>%s</p><a class="report-link" href="%s">Open report</a><div class="path-line">%s</div></div>',
        row$category,
        row$title,
        row$blurb,
        row$file,
        row$file
      ))
    }
    cat('</div>')
  }
}
```

)
